title: CI、构建与发布快速 Lane

root_causes.finding: One CI graph mixed source/Harness/Base SDK, component matrices, three-target Profile composition, Enterprise, app-directory smoke, formal Desktop bytes and admission; a component PR could reach RC-only work.
profile-release.yml rebuilt the complete component matrix and three Profile targets after CI when bootstrap=true; the coordinator hard-coded bootstrap=true instead of consuming accepted CI state.
The checked-in desired-state snapshot described 2.0.13 metadata but contained public 2.0.12/Base-v6 envelopes, so the 2.0.14 Profile release failed before publication.
A plugin lane Base SDK cache miss failed every affected component job without one recoverable seed producer.

Both Profile composition jobs depended on plugins but used ordinary job-level conditions. GitHub applied the implicit success status through the legally skipped component-base-sdk ancestor before evaluating the business predicate, so Base RC Profile generation was skipped even after plugins succeeded.

implementation.classifier: schema-v2 emate.ci-plan is the only path classifier output and selects pr-fast, release-candidate or audit
implementation.pr_fast: docs build nothing; affected components share one exact Base SDK artifact; Shell alone adds app-directory smoke; no installer or full three-target composition
implementation.release_candidate: Base source exports the already-built portable components, native target jobs export only target payloads, Profile candidates and formal Desktop bytes remain same-run artifacts
implementation.audit: manual/weekly full contracts, Enterprise and licenses; runtime performance is optional and non-blocking
implementation.publication: Profile publication validates and downloads exact CI artifacts, then signs/stages a bundle without rebuilding
implementation.cache: Base SDK, target Python runtime, Vision wheels, pnpm, Yarn and Electron use real input identities; job summaries expose seconds and cache state

timing_baseline.interpretation: observed baseline only; not a release or PR gate
